cards.title: About GPX Format
cards.body: GPX (GPS Exchange Format) is an XML-based format for GPS data. It's widely used by GPS devices, fitness trackers, and navigation apps to store waypoints, tracks, and routes.

cards.title: About GeoJSON Format
cards.body: GeoJSON is a JSON-based format for encoding geographic data structures. It's widely supported by web mapping libraries and GIS software, making it ideal for web applications.

cards.title: Why Convert GPX to GeoJSON?
items: Better support in web mapping libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox, etc.)
Easier to parse and manipulate in JavaScript applications
More compact format compared to XML-based GPX
Native JSON structure works seamlessly with modern web APIs
